_notes: OmniRoute: keep base_url as above; 'auto' or your own combo name lets OmniRoute's routing pick the model.

Provider API instead: base_url e.g. https://api.groq.com/openai/v1 , https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai , https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 , https://api.mistral.ai/v1 ; api_key_env = name of the env var holding your key; chains = that provider's model ids.
Unset chains fall back to default. Delete this _notes key if you like.
